messages:
incident-bot: PAGING — SLO breach detected for customer 'Opal' (single-tenant). p99 latency = 8.4s, p95 = 1.2s, streaming stalls observed. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/ops/opal/p99 (auto-alert)

jamal: oncall here, acknowledged. region/cluster? customer-facing impact?

maria: opal-dedicated-us-east. Support reports: some sessions dropping mid-stream. Not full outage but elevated tail. Correlating with a spike of long emoji-heavy prompts + alot of concurrent sessions (~180 concurrent).

ryan: checking infra now — pods for opal pool at 90-95% CPU and high net I/O. HPA didn't scale: replica cap set to 6.

maria: fwiw we landed a chunking/streaming tweak ~12m ago, commit 8f3d48. Might be related.

deploy-bot: deploy finished — serving-runtime@8f3d48 rolled to opal-dedicated-us-east 12 minutes ago (trigger: maria).

jamal: ok — probable sequence: new serving change + high-concurrency/long-prefix traffic -> KV cache churn / per-request CPU spike -> streaming stalls -> tail latency SLOs breached.

ryan: dump from cluster: ```
$ kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=opal-dedicated -o wide
opal-srv-0   2/2 Running   0    4m   10.0.3.12
opal-srv-1   2/2 Running   0    14m  10.0.3.13
opal-srv-2   2/2 Running   0    9m   10.0.3.14
opal-srv-3   2/2 Running   0    11m  10.0.3.15
opal-srv-4   2/2 Running   0    7m   10.0.3.16
opal-srv-5   2/2 Running   0    6m   10.0.3.17
$ kubectl top pods -n inference | grep opal
opal-srv-0   1800m/4000m   2.1Gi
opal-srv-1   1850m/4000m   2.4Gi
opal-srv-2   1750m/4000m   1.9Gi
```

ryan: rbctl describe pool opal-dedicated -> autoscale.maxReplicas=6 (set by customer contract), autoscale.policy=latency-avg.

jamal: mitigation options: 1) temporarily increase replica cap for this customer (ops+sales ok?) 2) route some traffic to fallback model variant (lower capacity) 3) enable/force KV prefix caching for Opal 4) apply emergency per-tenant concurrency cap. Which to do first?

maria: recommend 2+3 immediate. fallback -> reduces per-request latency and streaming load. KV caching should reduce token-generation CPU for repeated long prefixes. I'll prepare a quick toggle.

ryan: I can bump the replica cap temporarily as stopgap if sales is OK. Doing: ```
$ rbctl update-pool opal-dedicated --max-replicas=10
Updating pool... done. New maxReplicas=10
$ rbctl scale --pool=opal-dedicated --replicas=9
Scaling... success. currentReplicas=9
```

maria: toggling tenant KV cache mode now: ```
# flip tenant flag to enable prefix-kv-cache
$ curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood.internal/tenants/opal/config -d '{"kv_cache_mode":"aggressive"}'
{"status":"ok","kv_cache_mode":"aggressive"}
```

jamal: initiating routing override to fallback model variant (model: redwood-llama-medium) for Opal: ```
$ rbctl set-routing --tenant=opal --policy=force-model:redwood-llama-medium --duration=15m
Applied routing override for tenant=opal (15m)
```

sofia: metrics update — baseline vs now. (from infra metrics) ```
Before mitigation (10:12): p95=1.2s, p99=8.4s, streaming errors=1.8%
After scale + kv-cache + routing (10:30): p95=0.9s, p99=1.7s, streaming errors=0.3%
Note: p99 dropped but still above target; continuing to monitor.
```

jamal: good progress. Customer Ops flagged but reported degraded ux only, not complete failures. Notifying acct team now. @maria can you open a rollback PR for 8f3d48 if we confirm root cause?

maria: yes, opening PR to revert chunking tweak and adding extended unit tests for long-emoji sequences. PR: https://git.redwood/serving/PR/4321 — cc @ryan for infra impact.

ryan: infra will leave replica cap at 9 for 1 hour then reduce back to contractual limit; will document temporary ops change.

jamal: creating incident ticket and oncall handoff. Actions: 1) follow-up postmortem (maria) 2) infra rollback/validation (ryan) 3) customer follow-up and RCA (eng+support) 4) update SLO alert thresholds & add per-tenant concurrency safeguard (sofia).

maria: assigning myself for root cause and PR. I'll validate that enabling kv-cache didn't mask other issues.

sofia: I'll file monitoring task to track similar patterns across other single-tenant pools (long-prefix + emoji).

jamal: handing off to morning shift at 11:00. Current status: mitigations applied, p99 decreased to ~1.7s, customer stable but degraded. Follow-up ticket: INC-2026. Please add notes to the ticket as you make changes.

ryan: quick note — we saw ~22% CPU reduction per pod after routing override to medium model.

maria: thanks team. will post postmortem draft in #postmortems tomorrow.

jamal: thanks all. ping if regressions. :thumbsup:
